documents.text: Apple reported record quarterly revenue driven by strong iPhone and services growth.
Apple faces an EU antitrust investigation over App Store fees and developer terms.
Apple warned of supply chain constraints affecting Mac and iPad production this quarter.
Apple guided next-quarter revenue slightly below expectations citing a stronger dollar.
Microsoft cloud revenue rose as Azure growth accelerated on AI demand.
Microsoft's Activision acquisition drew regulatory scrutiny from the FTC and CMA.
Microsoft cited data-center capacity limits constraining Azure AI service availability.
Microsoft raised full-year guidance on strong Copilot and cloud bookings.
Coca-Cola posted higher organic revenue on pricing and resilient global demand.
Coca-Cola faces a US tax dispute with the IRS over transfer pricing of billions.
Coca-Cola noted higher input costs for aluminum and sweeteners pressuring margins.
Coca-Cola reaffirmed full-year organic revenue growth guidance despite currency headwinds.
